✨ **The Aesthetic Edge Podcast | Featuring Peel House** ✨  

In this episode, host **Bethany Gifford** sits down with the founders of **Peel House**, a trailblazing medical aesthetics practice on Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, D.C. Known for their inclusive approach and personalized care, Peel House is redefining what it means to thrive in the **beauty and wellness industry**.  

💡 **What You’ll Learn in This Episode:**  
- How Peel House is reshaping **medical aesthetics with inclusivity** at its core  
- Why the founders’ diverse backgrounds fuel their **unique business vision**  
- The role of **client archetypes** in tailoring services and creating lasting results  
- Insights into the innovative **Glowtox treatment** (chemical peels + neurotoxins)  
- Why **education on skin tones** is key for effective treatments  
- Operational strategies: **financials, membership retention & growth metrics**  
- Current trends in aesthetics: **natural beauty & holistic wellness**  
- Peel House’s **future goals**—expanding wellness offerings and addressing menopause support  

Whether you’re an industry professional or a beauty enthusiast, this episode offers powerful takeaways on client care, business development, and the evolving world of aesthetics.

add in a short descritpon of my three guests: SORELLE COOPER, FNP-BC
President & CEO
Sorelle Cooper is a board-certified Nurse Practitioner with more than 19 years of experience in healthcare. She holds a B.A. and a B.S. with honors from the State University of New York at Buffalo and a Master of Science in Nursing degree from Johns Hopkins University. Her vast professional skill set has afforded her opportunities to care for patients both across the U.S. and internationally.

Formerly a primary care provider, Sorelle has spent years cultivating her knowledge and feeding her passion for all things medical aesthetics. She specializes in dozens of injection techniques to enhance and restore the features of the face and body. She has worked in dermatology, plastic surgery, and aesthetics practices in the DC/MD/VA Metro area and specializes in delivering spectacularly natural-looking results. She believes that finding pleasure in one’s own appearance can positively impact confidence, and thus, the greater life experience.

She enjoys educating others about aesthetics and had the honor to participate in and produce several panel discussions regarding this rapidly growing field. She also has the distinction of being a DermCare Team Member of the American Academy of Dermatology and an aesthetic consultant to Rabito Clinic, the largest provider of dermatology services in Ghana, West Africa.

WENDY PITTMAN
Vice President of Business Development
Wendy Pittman has been a transformative leader in medical aesthetics for over two decades, building a distinguished career at the intersection of innovation, business growth, and patient care excellence. With deep expertise in business development and a sharp eye for emerging markets, Wendy has played pivotal roles in bringing iconic treatments to market, including BOTOX® Cosmetic, Allergan® Medical’s Hylacross® and Vycross® soft tissue filler technologies, Latisse®, and Kybella®.

Her proven success in the industry propelled her into senior leadership roles, where she directed sales operations across multiple states at organizations such as Evolus, Vitality Institute, and Venus Concept. Wendy’s leadership consistently drove revenue growth, expanded brand presence, and cultivated teams known for understanding customer needs and delivering results.

As a former stakeholder at the Vitality Institute, Wendy was instrumental in shaping national business development initiatives, spearheading corporate strategy, and building influential partnerships with key opinion leaders. She also proudly founded The Brown Skin Agenda, a groundbreaking, physician-led initiative that advances treatment protocols and skincare solutions for skin of color, enhancing awareness and practitioner education nationwide.

Wendy is currently an executive board member of the Capitol Hill Business Improvement District (BID), where she leverages her business acumen and passion for community development to advocate for small businesses and drive initiatives that enrich Washington, DC’s vibrant Capitol Hill corridor.

She attributes her drive for excellence to collaborative relationships with industry leaders who share her vision for advancing evidence-based practices and innovative strategies that set new standards in patient care.

Wendy holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Maryland, College Park.



SONYA LOWERY-YOUNG, LE
Chief Brand Officer
Sonya Lowery-Young is a licensed Medical Aesthetician in Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, with a clinical focus on skin-of-color and aging skin. As the visionary behind Peel Haus, she helped bring to life a shared vision for a welcoming, inclusive space that blends clinical expertise with cutting-edge aesthetic medicine. Alongside her partners, Sonya helped develop many of the practice’s signature combination therapies—like GloTox—that pair injectables, chemical peels, and advanced skin treatments for results that are both natural-looking and transformative.
Sonya began her aesthetics career under the mentorship of one of the nation’s leading dermatologists, where she developed a deep foundation in clinical skincare and corrective treatments. Today, she’s known for her skill in treating hyperpigmentation, melasma, sun damage, acne, and age-related skin changes, with a special emphasis on restoring confidence in every client she sees. Her go-to modalities include HydraFacial, IPL, chemical peels, microneedling, laser hair removal, and ClearLift laser—combined with tailored skincare routines that support long-term skin health.
She is certified by both the Aveda Institute and The Esthetic Institute of Virginia and brings experience in beauty, wellness, and media to her practice. Sonya has been nationally recognized in Upscale Magazine, The Network Journal (as a 40 Under 40 honoree), and on the cover of Heart & Soul Magazine. Her global perspective and passion for inclusive beauty continue to guide the Peel Haus philosophy: expert-driven care, personalized results, and a space where every client feels seen.
Meet Our Team

As the only Aesthetic & Plastic Surgery center on Capitol Hill, it was important to put together a dream team of highly skilled and accredited professionals. With a focus on inclusion in skin care, we are very proud of our staff and are here to serve you. We have a team of highly-trained and certified professionals including a Medical Aesthetician, a board-certified Nurse Practitioner Injector, and a team of exceptional Board-Certified Plastic Surgeons that are ready to help you meet all of your aesthetic needs.
